# ”Som att Volvo och Ferrari måste värderas på samma sätt”

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-04-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's analysts discuss a strong week for markets. The Stockholm exchange is near its all-time high, small caps rose 5% in the week and the S&P 500 is at record levels as investors bet on peace. They call the Sivers Semiconductors and Allbirds surges clear signs of an AI bubble, and note weak early Q1 reports from Ericsson, Nederman, Kinnevik and Byggmax, while MilDef and TF Bank/Avarda look strong. Looking ahead to next week's reports, they are cautious on Swedish banks because profits are falling, though they still favour Nordea, and they discuss consumer names that may see a pandemic-era replacement cycle.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 85%

Hosts call the rally a clear bubble driven by US retail investors. SEK 8bn valuation but no profits.

#### Reasoning

The price tripled or more on hype from a US influencer who compares it with profitable US peers. The company has sales of a few hundred million and has never made money. The hosts see some option value in the technology but say it is not worth SEK 8bn and expect a sharp fall when sentiment turns. They would not short it because of the momentum risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company shows real profitability and large orders
- if a US listing brings lasting institutional demand

> *"Det här är ju en bubbla, det är inget snack om det."*

---

### ⛔ BIRD — Allbirds | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Shoe company pivoted to GPU rental and jumped 600%. Hosts see it as a bubble indicator.

#### Reasoning

The stock fell about 99% and then jumped 600% on a pivot to renting out GPUs. The hosts compare it with the bitcoin-treasury craze and say it should be worth about what its GPUs cost. They expect this particular bubble to crash.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the GPU rental business shows sustainable returns above asset value

> *"Just den här bubblan kommer att krascha även om jag inte tror att GPU som koncept kommer att krascha."*

---

### 🟢 C — Citigroup | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Agneta is long Citi after CEO Jane Fraser's turnaround: profit up 52% and an expectations beat of 24%.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. The restructuring cut staff from 240k to 180k under a new strategy, and the latest report showed a strong profit rise and the biggest beat among the US banks. The market reaction was muted (+2.6%).

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround stalls or costs rise again
- if private equity and credit stress hit results

> *"Jane Fraser där har ju gjort ett enormt arbete med att vända den jätteskutan."*

---

### 🟠 NMAN — Nederman | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Robban has been tempted but sees no turnaround. Orders fell 6.7% and the margin is down, so don't rush in.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. It is a quality air-filtration company that depends on European industrial investment, which is weak. P/E stays flat because profits fall with the price. There is upside when the cycle turns thanks to operating leverage, but he wants to see order growth first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if orders keep falling
- if the margin keeps shrinking

> *"Den här rapporten visar just att man nog inte ska ha för bråttom in."*

---

### 🟢 MILDEF — MilDef | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Raised profit guidance with very strong sales and a big margin jump. The stock rose about 30% and the hosts call the move justified.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say the report shows everything you want to see: higher sales plus a big margin increase. Demand is arriving earlier than expected in the defence cycle as customers secure capacity. Robban considered it for the DI small-cap portfolio but passed, and regrets it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin gain proves temporary
- if defence orders slow

> *"Superstarka siffror. Det gick 33% på den under våren. Jag tyckte att det var helt motiverat."*

---

### ⛔ KINV-B — Kinnevik | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Large write-downs (about 23% on average) and high admin costs. Ålandsbanken calls it uninvestable, and the stock is at 2008 levels.

#### Reasoning

This combines host opinion and a cited analyst (Ålandsbanken). The acting CEO is clearing the decks for a new CEO. There are no new investments, and private equity valuations are under pressure. The market was right about the discount to asset value, and a turnaround looks difficult, as seen at Ratos.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a new CEO presents a credible strategy
- if portfolio valuations stabilize

> *"Ålandsbanken skrev ju här en kommentar att de ser att Kinnevik är oinvesterbart"*

---

### 🟢 TFBANK — TF Bank / Avarda | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Return on equity 26%, cost/income 35%, 13x expected profit, and growth in German credit cards and payments.

#### Reasoning

This is Agneta's opinion. The new IT platform lets it move capital between markets and products, and the strategy is shifting toward fintech and payments. Credit losses fell to 5.8% but are still high, so they must be managed. She still finds it interesting because it keeps delivering and is doing the right things.

#### Sell Triggers

- if card credit losses rise sharply
- if growth in German credit cards slows

> *"Jag tycker fortfarande det ser intressant ut för det rullar på och de gör rätt saker."*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Agneta recommends buying. It has the most analyst buy ratings (60%) and 11% upside, but expectations are high before the report.

#### Reasoning

This combines host opinion with cited analyst consensus. It has gained market share in mortgages and corporate activity has been positive, but profits are falling on lower net interest income and it takes a SEK 2bn restructuring cost. Since it has been the most positive bank, it must deliver on what it has said.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q1 report disappoints on loan demand
- if net interest income falls faster than expected

> *"rekommenderar ett köp på Nordea och jag tror det här håller i sig"*

---

### 🟡 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Only 1 of 23 analysts says buy and it trades above target, but Robban sees it as a relatively safe place for money at P/E about 12.

#### Reasoning

This combines host opinion and analyst consensus. Falling profits and little upside, but low risk compared with uncertain industrial companies. Robban became less keen after the analyst data yet prefers it over speculative names.

#### Sell Triggers

- if profits fall faster than expected
- if more analysts downgrade

> *"Jag köper hellre för Handelsbanken än Civus om man säger så."*

---

### 🟠 INDT — Indutrade | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Nordea issued a buy recommendation today. Robban looks forward to the report after a long period of weak performance.

#### Reasoning

The buy rating is cited from Nordea. Robban notes it is one of the worst-performing serial acquirers, both in share price and operations, so the report is a key test.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report shows continued organic decline

> *"Nu har Nordea idag kommit med en köprekommendation på Indutrade."*
